components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main booking or save action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 28px; overflow: hidden; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-plum); color: #fff8fa; font: 600 .92rem 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 12px 42px -20px rgb(221 118 153 / .8); transition: background-color 350ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow 450ms, transform 450ms; } .ds-btn-primary::after { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(110deg,transparent 25%,rgb(255 255 255 / .17) 50%,transparent 75%); content: ''; transform: translateX(-130%); transition: transform 800ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-plum-hover); box-shadow: 0 18px 46px -18px rgb(221 118 153 / .82); transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transform: translateX(130%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0a4bf; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Dark plum field for search, booking, and admin forms.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 11px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1rem 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; transition: border-color 220ms, box-shadow 220ms; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-plum); outline: 2px solid var(--color-plum); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Quiet primary navigation with a growing underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 1rem 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 220ms; } .ds-nav-link::after { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 8px; left: 12px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; content: ''; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page] { color: var(--color-plum); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link[aria-current=page]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-plum); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Filter
components.description: Shareable category filter with a clear selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 .9375rem 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color 220ms, border-color 220ms, background-color 220ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-plum); color: var(--color-plum); } .ds-chip[aria-current=true] { border-color: var(--color-plum); background: var(--color-plum); color: var(--color-surface); }

components.name: Velvet Service Listing
components.description: Dimensional service panel with a rose-lit accent and pointer response.
components.css: .ds-service { position: relative; min-height: 100%; border: 1px solid rgb(240 164 191 / .2); border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(160deg,rgb(255 255 255 / .07),transparent 58%),var(--color-surface); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 28px 80px -34px rgb(0 0 0 / .78); transition: transform 600ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),border-color 450ms,box-shadow 450ms; } .ds-service:hover { border-color: rgb(240 164 191 / .7); transform: translateY(-8px) rotateX(var(--tilt-x,0deg)) rotateY(var(--tilt-y,0deg)); box-shadow: 0 36px 90px -42px #000,0 0 36px -24px rgb(240 164 191 / .4); } .ds-service h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink); font: 400 2rem/1.12 'Instrument Serif', Georgia, serif; } .ds-service p { color: var(--color-rose); font: 600 .875rem 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: The website feels like entering a beauty studio after dark: deep plum surfaces, luminous rose accents, full-bleed close-up photography, and oversized Instrument Serif headlines. Category imagery and photo-led work panels give each service its own stage while Instrument Sans keeps navigation, booking, pricing, and studio operations clear. Motion is part of the experience. The home image opens through a curved curtain reveal; titles rise through a brief blur; service and gallery pieces reveal in sequence; the service ribbon glides continuously; desktop cards respond to pointer position; and navigation moves through short scene transitions. Reduced-motion and touch layouts stop continuous movement and remove the image parallax and mask. Booking and admin keep their tasks and controls easy to find.
keyCharacteristics: Deep plum stage with rose light and a clear reading order.
Full-bleed, configured service and salon photography.
Layered image surfaces and dimensional service pieces.
Kinetic display type, sequential reveals, and scene-to-scene transitions.
A restrained reduced-motion mode that preserves the finished page.

rules.name: The Headline Has a Stage Rule
rules.body: Oversized display type belongs on high-level brand moments; price, duration, forms, and admin labels stay direct and compact.

rules.name: The Safe Performance Rule
rules.body: Animate transforms, opacity, filter, and clipping. Use IntersectionObserver and requestAnimationFrame; remove depth movement for coarse pointers and reduced-motion preferences.

dos: Do keep the real studio's service, price, rating, and location facts intact.
Do use configured photography on Home, Services, Work, and the booking introduction, retaining declared alt text and crop ratios.
Do keep booking controls and admin information easy to scan.
Do respect reduced motion and disable continuous depth on touch screens.
donts: Don't invent staff identities, testimonials, certifications, opening hours, or treatment results.
Don't add unconfigured photos, fake metrics, or fabricated testimonials.
Don't imply online availability while the booking setting is closed.
